metadata.description: Curated plugins for AI-assisted work: UI/UX excellence, session auto-naming and handoff, prompt engineering, and structured planning.

plugins.name: ui-excellence
plugins.description: Comprehensive UI/UX skills for web interfaces — 13 skills with triage coordinator spanning visual design, typography, accessibility, usability audits, conversion optimization, microinteractions, and engagement loops.

plugins.name: smart-session-rename-cc
plugins.description: Auto-name your Claude Code sessions. A Stop hook watches your conversation, scores work-density deterministically, and asks Haiku for a `domain: clauses` title when meaningful work has accumulated. Seven /smart-rename subcommands give you manual override, anchoring, freeze/force, and inspection.

plugins.name: prompt-master
plugins.description: Generates optimized prompts for AI tools (LLMs, image/video AI, coding agents). Activates only on explicit prompt-engineering requests — not for general conversation or coding tasks. Vendored from nidhinjs/prompt-master via git subtree, kept in sync via weekly GitHub Action.

plugins.name: generate-session-prompt
plugins.description: Generate a handoff prompt to resume development work in a new session. Use when sessions exceed ~150k tokens, when resuming after a pause, when switching tools, or on context shifts. Accepts a detail level (brief, standard, detailed). Auto-detects mode: opinionated when `.planning/` exists in the project root, generic otherwise.

plugins.name: enhanced-planning
plugins.description: Adds structural guardrails to implementation plans — human checkpoints, risk registry, named guardrails, decision locks, multi-session protocol, and Codex review. Complements (does not replace) writing-plans. Works standalone; pairs with /codex:rescue. Vendored from tech-product-template, synced weekly.

plugins.name: cmux-hibernate
plugins.description: Hibernate the Claude Code sessions across cmux workspaces: end the idle ones, which frees their memory, verify in cmux's autosave that they will not relaunch on reopen, and check or resume them afterwards.

plugins.name: multica-ops
plugins.description: Companion to the official multica-cli skill, not a replacement: where the binary hides in a desktop-app install, how to reach it from a bridged Cowork/claude.ai session, the shell and JSON shapes the reference does not state, the platform limits, and the constraints of working a board governed by a repository that versions its Multica configuration.

plugins.name: decisoes
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod (function-hooks plugin) that collects, per session, the decisions only the session's owner can make — a tool the agent calls plus lines flagged in its text — lets you answer them with buttons in a band and a pane, lists the other cmux sessions waiting on you, and asks a session to land before you close the machine. Texts in Portuguese.
